# Globe Gazers

> > Globe Gazers provides comprehensive solo female travel guides, safety tips, and destination resources for women travelers exploring the world independently.

Founded by travel expert Nausheen, Globe Gazers offers practical advice and detailed destination guides for popular locations including Chiang Mai, Santorini, and Mexico, with a focus on empowering women to travel safely and confidently on their own.
